_doc: Made by tests/make_puzzles.gd. Each foe is tuned so `best` wins with stars and a careless layout loses.

puzzles.d: Whetstones sharpen the weapons they touch. Put each one between blades.
There is more than the pack can hold. Leave out what does not help this fight.
The Boulder Maul adds Shield to every Armor it touches. Put it in the middle of your armor.
A Fire Gem turns the weapons it touches into Fire. Burn keeps hurting a monster that heals.
This monster resists Fire. Pick the weapons that hit it for full damage.
Armored monsters take less Physical damage. An Armor Breaker lets the weapons it touches pierce it.
Mana Crystals and the Mana Prism speed up the Spells they touch. Every Spell should touch at least one.
A Spirit Totem makes the Beasts it touches hit harder. Two totems, three beasts: make every beast touch both.
The Twin-Fang Ring strikes again when a Weapon touching it crits; a Shadow Cloak makes the weapons it touches crit more. Build a crit corner.
The bot beat this boss with these items. Can you?

mech.d: Every 10s a huge breath hits for 4× its attack. Have Shield ready!
